hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Determine the quantity of even and odd values available within the range 1 to m.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: A pair of adjacent elements increment the even pair count if and only if both numbers are even.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Track the number of valid prefixes having j even pairs while distinguishing whether the last placed number was even or odd.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countOfArrays(self, n: int, m: int, k: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        even = m // 2
        odd = m - even
        
        dp = [[0, 0] for _ in range(k + 1)]
        dp[0][0] = even
        dp[0][1] = odd
        
        for _ in range(2, n + 1):
            new_dp = [[0, 0] for _ in range(k + 1)]
            for j in range(k + 1):
                from_even = dp[j - 1][0] if j > 0 else 0
                from_odd = dp[j][1]
                new_dp[j][0] = ((from_even + from_odd) * even) % MOD
                new_dp[j][1] = ((dp[j][0] + dp[j][1]) * odd) % MOD
            dp = new_dp
            
        return (dp[k][0] + dp[k][1]) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(n * k) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(k) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(n * k) complexity.
